2d48e4fdb80e60a3.title: UI Designer 交互视觉设计师
2d48e4fdb80e60a3.jd_text:
岗位职责：
1.负责 PC 端、移动端、Web 整体视觉风格和 UI 设计，定义并管理设计资源；
2.负责制定视觉与交互的相关设计方法，帮助创造良好体验的产品与服务；
3.参与产品和业务的规划，并提供专业意见；
4.负责优化项目流程和设计过程，并建立设计规范，推动统一的产品设计标准；
5.与产品团队、开发团队、项目管理团队以及合规性和安全性团队等沟通协作，制定详细、适用的产品、解决方案设计实施计划；
任职资格:
1. 本科及以上学历，视觉传达、艺术设计、美术学等相关专业毕业；
2.5 年以上移动端、PC 端产品设计经验，熟悉视觉设计相关方法，熟练使用设计软件，具备 UI 动效设计能力；
3.有完整的项目案例，能够独立中大型项目的UI设计，搭建组件库，制定设计规范； 在产品市场调研、用户故事设计、敏捷产品开发、用户体验和用户界面设计有扎实的知识和丰富的经验；
4.具备良好的审美能力和洞察力，具备较强的学习意识和能力，能够创造性的提出设计方案并落地；
5.在制药/医疗健康行业多个接触点的客户体验、服务设计和旅程管理以及产品设计方面的工作经验，有扎实的市场趋势知识，了解制药/医疗健康行业最新的数字产品和应用；
6.擅长跨职能沟通，能够管理与业务利益相关者的高效沟通
7.具有创新和创业精神，能够在模糊和复杂的环境中管理优先事项、解决障碍、做出决策并产生影响

3e3701e39ae8c5d4.jd_text:
To succeed in this role you must have experience in and be able to:
- Design and develop integration solutions for applications, ensuring they align with business and technical requirements.
- Conduct in-depth analysis to understand the underlying problems associated with integration challenges and propose effective solutions.

- Fluency in Chinese (Mandarin) and English, proficiency in both English speaking and writing
Preferred Qualifications:
- Experience designing SaaS products for a B2B company
- Experience in the cloud-based communications and collaborations industry
- Experience working on global and remote teams
- Experience in Figma
- Ability to plan/facilitate workshops and group design activities

a39aaddac070fe95.title: CreateSmart Creative Design Lead
a39aaddac070fe95.jd_text:
Job Summary
The CreateSmart Creative Design Lead will be responsible for building, leading, and continuously elevating the creative design capability within the Medical Content Team, enabling high-quality visual communication across diverse medical content and business scenarios. This role will oversee the delivery of key visuals, banners, posters, medical presentation design, digital assets, and multimedia content.
This position requires strong creative and design expertise, with the ability to lead high-complexity design assignments while demonstrating outstanding team leadership, cross-functional orchestration, and AI-enabled design capability. The role will work closely with BU stakeholders, content teams, and medical review teams to ensure creative outputs are visually compelling, strategically aligned, medically appropriate, and review-ready.
Responsibilities
Creative Design Leadership: Lead high-complexity creative design projects, including key visuals, banners, posters, presentation visual design, digital materials, and multimedia content. Ensure all creative outputs demonstrate strong visual quality, brand consistency, medical communication relevance, and alignment with business objectives.
Design Team Leadership: Lead, manage, and coach the design team. Allocate design resources effectively, review creative quality, establish clear working standards, delivery timelines, and feedback mechanisms, and continuously enhance the team’s creative capability and execution efficiency.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Serve as the key creative interface between the design team, BU stakeholders, content teams, and medical review teams. Accurately interpret business needs, content priorities, and review requirements, and translate them into clear creative briefs and actionable design directions.
Complex Project Orchestration: Oversee priority projects and high-complexity design assignments, including requirement clarification, creative direction setting, visual solution evaluation, project timeline management, and final quality control to ensure on-time and high-standard delivery.
Design System & Process Optimization: Establish and continuously optimize design SOPs, creative templates, presentation master layouts, visual guidelines, and reusable asset libraries to improve consistency, scalability, and operational efficiency across design deliverables.
AI-Enabled Creative Production: Explore and drive the application of AI capabilities in the design workflow, supporting creative ideation, visual exploration, layout optimization, content adaptation, and production efficiency improvement. Develop practical methodologies and governance principles for AI-assisted design.
Education and Experience
Bachelor’s degree or above in Visual Communication Design, Graphic Design, Digital Media Design, Multimedia Design, Advertising Design, or other related design disciplines is required. Master’s degree in a design-related discipline is highly preferred.
Minimum 8-10 years of relevant design experience, preferably gained from leading advertising agencies, creative agencies, digital marketing agencies, healthcare communication agencies, or in-house creative teams.
Prior experience as Creative Design Lead, Visual Design Lead, Senior Art Lead, Design Team Lead, or equivalent leadership role is highly preferred.
Experience in healthcare, pharmaceutical, life sciences, medical communication, or professional content platforms is a strong plus.
Proven track record in delivering high-quality creative work, leading design teams, managing complex design projects, and driving cross-functional collaboration.
Technical Skills Requirements
Advanced Design Expertise: Strong visual design capability, including layout, typography, color, composition, visual hierarchy, brand consistency, and digital content adaptation.
High-Complexity Design Delivery: Ability to independently assess and lead complex design assignments, provide clear creative direction, and translate complex medical or scientific content into clear, professional, engaging, and audience-appropriate visual communication.
Team Leadership Capability: Proven experience in managing design teams, including resource allocation, creative quality review, capability development, workflow optimization, and performance enablement.
Mature & Strategic Communication Skills: Excellent cross-functional communication and coordination skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with BU stakeholders, content teams, and medical review teams. Able to understand diverse stakeholder needs and drive alignment toward high-quality execution.
Project Management Excellence: Demonstrated ability to manage multiple design projects simultaneously, prioritize resources effectively, and ensure high-quality delivery under fast-paced timelines.
AI Application Capability: Strong awareness and practical capability in AI-assisted design. Able to integrate AI capabilities into creative ideation, visual exploration, and design production workflows to enhance efficiency, innovation, and creative quality.

c0f061d97104304c.title: Platform Engineering - Dev/UX (Production Website), Off
c0f061d97104304c.jd_text:
Who We Are Looking For
State Street Investment Management is seeking a hands-on Senior Software Engineer for our China office as part of the Information Technology organization.
The successful candidate will support business-critical applications and infrastructure for stakeholders, including application support, BAU activities, and issue resolution for State Street Investment Management applications.
Why This Role is Important to Us
Our Information Technology function plays a critical and strategic role at State Street Investment Management, serving as a core enabler in delivering data‑driven insights and digital capabilities to our clients. We continue to modernize our technology landscape through cloud adoption, advanced data analytics, and automation initiatives, strengthening our ability to support evolving business needs.
This role supports business-critical applications with a strong emphasis on technical troubleshooting, application support, automation, and stakeholder collaboration.
What You Will Be Responsible For
- Design, develop, test, maintain, and support enterprise applications and backend services in accordance with established software development lifecycle (SDLC) standards.
- Take ownership of assigned applications, components, or services from requirements analysis through production deployment, BAU support, and ongoing issue resolution.
- Ensure applications meet performance, security, availability, and scalability requirements.
- Produce and maintain technical documentation to support application support and future enhancements
- Collaborate effectively with business users, infrastructure teams, vendors, and global technology partners to resolve incidents and service requests in a timely manner.
- Develop and maintain backend services using Java and Springboot:
Design, build, and support RESTful APIs
Develop and maintain database solutions, including data modeling and SQL development
Integrate backend services with frontend applications and third party systems
Support service oriented and microservices based architectures
- Develop and maintain quick web based demo and service using skills:
HTML
CSS
JavaScript
React JS
What We Value
- Strong sense of ownership and accountability for delivery, quality, and system stability
- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision
- Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills
- Clear and effective written and verbal communication skills
Education & Preferred Qualifications/Skills
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field
- 5+ years of hands-on development, application support, or technical troubleshooting experience with at least one programming language.
- Experience with microservices or distributed systems
- Exposure to cloud platforms or container based deployment models
- Prior experience in financial services or regulated industries
Where Will The Role Be Based
The role will be based in Hangzhou, China.
Across the globe, institutional investors rely on us to help them manage risk, respond to challenges, and drive performance and profitability. We keep our clients at the heart of everything we do, and smart, engaged employees are essential to our continued success.
We are committed to fostering an environment where every employee feels valued and empowered to reach their full potential. As an essential partner in our shared success, you’ll benefit from inclusive development opportunities, flexible work-life support, paid volunteer days, and vibrant employee networks that keep you connected to what matters most. Join us in shaping the future.

d52c58d8654103b3.title: CHK CBG Design Manager
d52c58d8654103b3.jd_text:
职位描述
CHK Design Manager
Collaborate with Innovative 3Mers Around the World
This position provides an opportunity to transition from other private, public, experience to a 3M career.
The Impact You’ll Make in This Role
The CHK Designer is a design leader responsible for setting mid-term to long-term design strategy across all CBG brands and portfolios in China and Hong Kong. This role governs visual identity and brand standards, ensuring creative excellence throughout the consumer and customer journeys. The role integrates consumer insight, business strategy, and craft to build brand value, drive growth, and deliver differentiated, culturally relevant experiences to accelerate growth in the region. It combines strategic leadership with hands-on contribution, while building a local design team.
As a designer, you will have the opportunity to tap into your curiosity and collaborate with some of the most innovative people around the world. Here, you will make an impact by:
Leading the development and stewardship of brand design systems that create emotional connection and meet functional needs across China and Hong Kong.
Translating consumer insights into differentiated and desirable brand experiences across packaging, product, digital, retail, and communications.
Partnering with local business teams to align design strategy with growth objectives, new product innovation, and commercialization.
Key Responsibilities
Strategic Leadership and Brand Governance
- Lead the translation of global brand design strategy, including visual brand identity, brand architecture, design principles, and multi-touchpoint experience frameworks for China and Hong Kong.
- Establish and oversee brand governance, standards, and toolkits; ensure adherence across internal teams and external partners.
- Serve as brand steward—owning and evolving the brand system to support new product innovations, portfolio extensions, and entry into new categories.
- Integrate design strategy into local business planning, category roadmaps, and go-to-market activities.
Budget Ownership and Design Operations
- Own the design budget for assigned brands or portfolios within China and Hong Kong; forecast annually and manage monthly tracking.
- Open and manage purchase orders (POs), calibrate spend, and ensure fiscal discipline and transparency.
Consumer Insight and Research
- Champion consumer centricity: translate ethnographic research, segmentation, and behavioral insights into actionable design strategies tailored for the local market.
- Establish metrics/KPIs for brand experience performance and tie design outcomes to business results.
Creative Excellence and End-to-End Brand Experience
- Elevate creative craft and design intent across all touchpoints.
- Guide and partner with global CBG design team and external agencies on creative execution, ensuring brand coherence and quality.
People Leadership, Coaching, and Culture
- Mentor and coach local designers; lead critiques to elevate quality and consistency.
- Model a culture of curiosity, collaboration, and consumer empathy; inspire teams with a big heart for brand strategy and craft.
Your Skills and Expertise
To set you up for success in this role from day one, 3M requires (at a minimum) the following qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree (completed and verified prior to start) AND at least seven (7) years of professional experience in Design across multiple touchpoints (e.g., packaging, product, digital, retail, communications) in a private, public, government environment
Additional qualifications that could help you succeed even further in this role include:
- Bachelor’s degree or higher in Design, Visual Communication, Brand Strategy, Experience Design, or related field.
- 10–15+ years of experience in brand/experience design with demonstrated leadership of programs within China and/or Hong Kong.
- Proven success establishing and governing visual identity systems and multi-touchpoint brand experiences.
- Strong financial acumen and experience with budget management.
- Expertise in consumer research translation (ethnography, segmentation) into design strategy and commercialization.
- Demonstrated ability to lead agencies and cross-functional teams; excellent communication, storytelling, and influence skills.
- Portfolio showcasing strategic brand systems and high-quality execution across packaging, digital, and communications.
- Proficiency using tools like Adobe Creative Suite, MS office, AI/Automation enablement
Work Location:
This role follows a hybrid/on-site working model, requiring the employee to work at least four days a week at the 3M Office in Shanghai, China.
Travel:
May include travel within China and Hong Kong, up to 20%.
Learn more about 3M’s creative solutions to the world’s problems at www.3M.com or on Instagram, Facebook, and LinkedIn @3M.
Safety is a core value at 3M. All employees are expected to contribute to a strong Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) culture by following safety policies, identifying hazards, and engaging in continuous improvement.
